{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma2
|version1= 1.00

|game2= arma2oa
|version2= 1.50

|game3= tkoh
|version3= 1.00

|game4= arma3
|version4= 0.50

|arg= global
|eff= global

|gr1= Groups

|descr= Joins the unit to the given group, if position id is available, this one is used. Avoid any radio communication related to joining.

|s1= unit [[joinAsSilent]] [group, id]

|p1= unit: [[Object]]

|p2= group: [[Group]]

|p3= id: [[Number]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>player joinAsSilent [_group, 4];</sqf>

|x2= To get the position id:
<sqf>
getUnitPositionId = {
	private ["_vvn", "_str"];
	_vvn = vehicleVarName _this;
	_this setVehicleVarName "";
	_str = str _this;
	_this setVehicleVarName _vvn;
	parseNumber (_str select [(_str find ":") + 1])
};
player joinAsSilent [createGroup west, 5];
_id = player call getUnitPositionId;
hint str _id; // 5
</sqf>

|seealso= [[join]] [[joinAs]] [[joinSilent]]
}}

{{Note
|user= Mach1723

|text= I have not done a thorough test but this function doesn't seem to work for Civilians, use [[joinSilent]] instead.
